developer.description: Drop a single Web Component into any web application or static site.

organizer.heading: I manage events
organizer.description: Need visual button management, RSVP forms, hosted .ics files, or event landing pages without writing code?
organizer.item-1-text: Configure buttons and event microsites visually.
organizer.item-2-text: Host dynamic .ics files and collect guest confirmations.
organizer.item-3-text: Post-save CTAs, API, webhooks, Zapier & Pipedream.

capabilities.heading: Built for edge cases & real-world events
capabilities.description: Calendar APIs and .ics specifications require careful platform handling. We solved every browser, protocol, and timezone anomaly so you don't have to.

calendars.title: All Major Calendars
calendars.description: Direct deep-links for web calendars (Google, Outlook, Office 365, Yahoo) alongside validated RFC 5545 .ics files for Apple and native desktop clients.

events.title: Flexible Event Types
events.description: Supports all-day events, multi-date schedules, recurring RRULE intervals, subscriptions, and dynamic date parameters updated via JavaScript.

timezones.title: Time Zones & DST
timezones.description: Detects the visitor's local browser timezone automatically and converts UTC offsets seamlessly, including Daylight Saving Time transitions.

browsers.title: Browser & Webview Handling
browsers.description: Rigorously tested across iOS Safari popup blockers, Android Chrome, in-app mobile webviews (Instagram, LinkedIn), and Outlook webmail protocols.

styling.title: Styling & 49+ Languages
styling.description: Custom themes, CSS custom variables, custom button labels, and automatic i18n localization in 49+ languages based on browser locale.

accessibility.title: Accessibility & Privacy
accessibility.description: WCAG AA compliant with keyboard and screen-reader support. 100% client-side execution, strict GDPR environments, and CSP nonce support.

comparison.heading: A button is enough - until it isn't.
comparison.description: Choose the free Web Component for custom codebases, or upgrade to PRO when you need visual management, RSVP tracking, and landing pages.
